content.comment_body: Is your [product_name] [article_no] functioning correctly when using input I7? Review the wiring for I7 and apply similar wiring to I8. As a test, you can swap I7 and I8. For analog input connections: ensure the positive analog output from the sensor is connected to the correct analog input (I7 = Ai1, I8 = Ai2). The negative terminal of the sensor should be connected to the common ground (M) of the [product_name] power supply. You can verify the inputs by checking the display: after date and time appear, press the cursor right or left until the analog input screen is shown. The actual input value will be displayed, ranging from 0 to 1000 (where 0V = 0 and 10V = 1000).
